To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we fabricated CSNMs with embedded Ag NPs in PEG/PCL shell and HA/ibuprofen in core through co-axially electrospinning.

the co-axial core-shell nanofiber membranes with embedded silver nanoparticles in the shell and ibuprofen in the HA core can effectively prevent peritendinitis and tendon adhesion after flexor tendon repair in a rabbit model.

the core-shell nanofiber membranes with silver nanoparticles and ibuprofen embedded in the shell and core, respectively, are promising as a multi-functional barrier membrane with anti-bacterial, anti-inflammation and anti-adhesion functions for tendon repair.
In summary, our research is concerned with

a multi-functional CSNM with a lubricated, anti-adhesive and anti-inflammatory effect and antibacterial property for the prevention of peritendinous fibrous adhesion and post-surgical tendon inflammation.
the design of a multi-functional electrospun nanofibrous membrane for the management of tendon adhesion and post-surgical inflammation.
the development of multi-functional core-shell electrospun nanofibrous membrane (CSNM) for the management of tendon adhesion.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

we developed CSNMs with embedded Ag NPs in a PEG/PDL shell and HA/ibuprofen in a core, which exhibited anti-adhesive, anti-infection, anti-inflammatory, anti-bacterial, and lubricating properties, and that the CSNM HI30/PPAs exhibited the best efficacy in the in vivo model.
HI30/CSNM is a multifunctional membrane with anti-adhesion, anti-inflammation and anti-infection properties for post-surgical tendon repair.
HI30/PA CSNMs can be considered as a promising candidate for the prevention of peritendinous fibrosis and adhesions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we developed a multi-functional electrospun core-shell nanofiber membrane with anti-adhesion and anti-inflammatory properties, which could be used as a promising candidate in tendon surgery to prevent post-surgical tendon peritendinous fibrosis and adhesion.
we developed a novel multi-functional electrospun core-shell nanofiber membrane with embedded ibuprofen and silver nanoparticles in the core and shell, respectively.
we successfully fabricated a novel multi-functional electrospun core-shell nanofibre membrane (CSNM) for prolonged prevention of tendon adhesion and post-operative inflammation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of HA/ibuprofen core and PEG/PCL shell in a CSNM is a promising approach to achieve multi-functionality for post-operative tendon adhesion management.
we developed a multifunctional core-shell nanofiber membrane with a lubricating effect, anti-inflammation and anti-infection properties.
CSNM with a lubricating core and an antibacterial shell is a promising anti-adhesion barrier membrane for tendon surgery.
